summary: Asset download uses a fixed '<name>.part' path shared by every synthesizer using the same cache_dir.
failure_scenario: Two processes or instances cold-start on one cache: the second unlinks the first's in-progress .part, so the first's partial.replace(path) raises FileNotFoundError (POSIX) or the unlink fails (Windows) -> startup failure, fail-closed, no corrupt asset accepted.
evidence: Source read of _ensure_asset only; not reproduced. Integrity is still verified by size and sha256, so impact is availability only.

summary: launcher.py LocalBrowserLauncher start/close: one-shot start, start-failure cleanup under shield, retryable close (a failed operation is replaced; each attempt records an immutable LAUNCHER close stage), provider and runtime closure flags prevent double closing on retry; SIGTERM handler is restored in finally.

production_observation.py: non-blocking append marks the trace incomplete on lock contention or capacity exhaustion without evicting earlier facts; rollover ordering is enforced and violations mark the trace incomplete; view/recorder binding is by identity equality.

voice_tail.py forget path: request_forget clears history and retires the binding in one synchronous transition before any await; the delete intent is recorded as pending only if a batch was offered (cursor set or frozen > 0); next_deletes waits for the durable tail write; acknowledge_forget settles only exact pending bindings and keeps the newest outcome; voice_forget._settle rejects replies naming another binding; host_launcher delete status is keyed on the exact old binding.

kokoro.py synthesize/cancel/close: per-turn operation ownership with identity checks, cancel pops and cancels the task, close sets closed first and then cancels operations and closes the worker under backend_lock; worker publication re-checks _closed so there is no leaked worker. Executor is single-worker, so a cancelled in-flight job cannot interleave with the next worker request.
